strengths: Complete, self-consistent identification: top-level id, doi and version all carry the June 2026 release identity (10.18130/V3/HIGT4C, V2.0), matching the citation, landing page and version_access

Typed related_datasets linking the release series (is_new_version_of) and its publications (is_described_by, is_referenced_by), plus a populated subpopulations slot with donor origins, RRIDs and per-condition distribution
Internally consistent non-human-subjects ethics posture with explicit negative declarations (sensitive_elements, content_warnings, at_risk_populations) rather than silent absences

End-to-end technical transparency: per-modality acquisition and collection detail, raw-data deposits (MassIVE, SRA, Figshare), the five-step MuSIC-style pipeline, GSAI annotation protocol and named tools

Rigorous source hygiene: per-release figures attributed to their releases, project-level portal counts and U2OS results excluded from slot values, byte counts omitted rather than fabricated from rounded sizes, and conflicts (Sali affiliation, committee name, project end date) caveated with the resolution reasoning
weaknesses: No variable-level metadata for any modality; is_tabular: false is the only structural flag
No formal errata slot despite documented revisions across the release series
Data payload formats inside the ZIP archives are not named, limiting format documentation to the packaging layer
No instance counts asserted for the June 2026 IF and AP-MS modalities (earlier-release counts are attributed but not carried forward)
No conflicts-of-interest statement or dated review record in ethical_reviews, and tool versions are absent from machine_annotation_tools
recommendations: Add variables (image channels, interaction table columns, perturbation atlas fields) and per-collection format detail for the archive payloads (e.g. TIFF images, mzML/RAW MS, FASTQ sequencing)
Record the June 2025 revision and the post-publication file additions as errata entries rather than only as related_datasets and distribution_dates notes
Obtain and assert June 2026 per-condition imaged-protein counts and AP-MS bait counts when the repository states them
Add tool versions to machine_annotation_tools (GPT-4 model version, node2vec/DenseNet-121/HiDeF releases) and consider populating software_and_tools directly
Add a regulatory_restrictions.confidentiality_level (public) and a reidentification-risk note for the donor-derived KOLF2.1J sequencing data
